title: salacia coriacea
intro: Salacia coriacea, commonly known as Kallu chedi or Salacia, is a plant species belonging to the family Celastraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing blood sugar levels, aiding in weight management, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Salacia coriacea are attributed to its ability to inhibit alpha-glucosidase, delay carbohydrate absorption, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
